freeze_before: safety-only ingestion and production derivative integration
rules: Freeze corpus hashes, host/browser version and cold/warm definition before production implementation changes.
No relaxing gates after observing failures; fix causes or report an unmet gate.
Heap snapshots and retained-object counts must corroborate trends; GC or RSS alone is insufficient.
Actual mobile-device coverage remains distinct from browser emulation.
Mock sandbox/model runs are regression coverage, not real backend or model acceptance.
Report request timing, CPU, RSS, disk, query/job counts, network bytes and model cost separately.
